text:
Jordan: quick heads-up — I just got a flight delay and need to swap primary for tonight (19:00-03:00 UTC). I still can be secondary if needed but can't be primary during the 21:00 maintenance window.

Priya: ok noted. are you talking the whole window or just the 21:00-22:30 part?

Jordan: whole shift block. 19:00 till 03:00 — I can't reliably respond during boarding/arrival.

Sam: I can take primary for 19:00-23:00 but then i have a meeting at 23:15 that I can't move.

Alex: I can cover 23:00-03:00 if Sam takes the first half. that gives overlap 23:00-23:15 which is fine.

Maya: i can shadow from 20:00-22:00 to help with the maintenance handoff, if needed.

oncall-bot: rotation-check: Jordan is currently scheduled primary for 2026-04-12 19:00-03:00 UTC. Please confirm swaps in this thread so audit logs update.

Jordan: thanks — proposal: Sam primary 19:00-23:00, Alex primary 23:00-03:00, Maya shadow 20:00-22:00, Priya remains secondary for whole block. everyone ok?

Priya: sounds reasonable. i'll stay secondary and take pager if either of you needs a hard escalate.

Sam: works for me. adding runbook pointers below.

Sam: Runbook snippets for tonight's maintenance and paging escalation:
```
- Primary on-call checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/primary-checklist
- Maintenance steps: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/maintenance/db-maint-2026-04
- Pager escalation: page -> oncall -> if no ack 2 mins -> page team lead -> PM oncall
- Quick diagnostics:
  curl -s https://telemetry.redwood/api/replica_lag | jq .lag
  tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/runtime.log | grep -i "replica"
```

Alex: flagged. i'll be at my laptop from 22:45 to be on top of the fallthrough.

Maya: i'll check the maintenance preflight at 20:00 (schema migration dry-run) and post a short status.

incident-bot: page: sev2 | replication-lag | 19:12 UTC | affected: hosted-api read replicas | pager: primary

Jordan: that incident earlier (19:12) is resolved but left the maintenance in a slightly fragile state. important we get the prefix cache warm before the maintenance starts.

Sam: noted. i'll run a quick cache-warm script at 20:30. command is:
```
ssh infra@ops "bash /opt/scripts/warm_prefix_cache.sh --model-all --concurrency 8"
```

Priya: i'll keep monitoring token costs and latencies on the console for the overlap window and call timeout if we see regressions.

Alex: two minor asks: (1) Sam, can you handoff a short summary in #eng-oncall 10 mins before 23:00? (2) Jordan, please update PagerDuty note that you're swapping tonight so incident logs show correct responder.

Sam: yep will post a 22:50 handoff.

Jordan: done — updated PD: note "temporary swap: Sam primary 19-23, Alex primary 23-03; Jordan secondary until 19:15 then off-grid".

deploy-bot: scheduled-deploy: maintenance-window 2026-04-12 21:00-21:45 UTC | ticket: MNT-4123 | owner: infra-team

Maya: ok i ran the preflight at 20:00: no schema diffs on staging, prefix cache warm OK for 80% models, a couple small latency blips — nothing blocking.

Priya: good signal. i'll post a brief watchlist with SLO thresholds in the channel at 20:45.

Alex: minor note — if the maintenance starts to cause >2x tail latency, follow rollback steps in runbook section 4.1. quick snippet:
```
# rollback
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/runtime-deployment --to-revision=REV
```

Sam: copied. if anything odd, page me immediately. i'll take initial ack for 19:00-23:00.

Jordan: thank you all. leaving primary assignment to you folks. feel free to ping me if escalation needed — i'll be reachable via DM until boarding.

Maya: thanks Jordan — safe travels.

Priya: confirmed swap in channel. will follow up with a short postmortem note in #incidents if anything happens.

oncall-bot: audit-log: rotation-swap recorded (old_primary: Jordan, new_primary_partial: Sam 19:00-23:00, new_primary_partial: Alex 23:00-03:00, secondary: Priya, shadows: Maya).

Sam: i'll update the wiki roster with the temporary swap for posterity. 22:50 handoff reminder set.

Alex: thanks team — i'll be on from 23:00. if you want me to pre-warm any models before taking over, tell me which ones.

Sam: please pre-warm: gpt-redwood-13b, embed-1024, reranker-v2.

Alex: will do, thanks.

Jordan: appreciate it. posting final note: "swap confirmed — Sam primary 19-23, Alex primary 23-03, Priya secondary, Maya shadow 20-22. maintenance watchlist and runbook pinned." :thumbsup:

Priya: acknowledged. closing thread once oncall-bot confirms final audit entry.

oncall-bot: rotation-swap complete and logged to audit (audit_id: 6b4f2c).

Priya: thread closed — thanks everyone.
